plan.title: Asset PR to RFQ Award and PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the PR flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Give the PR-created event a searchable title before publishing.
Verify that the requested quantity is 10 units.

args.goal: add one Required Terms and Conditions clause to the event and stop on the create screen showing the clause added

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute event duration; the separate evaluation duration cannot be configured by the catalog.
Invite the vendors mapped to the product without inventing supplier names.
Publish the completed single-stage RFQ.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit a quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Assert that the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Have a different invited vendor submit the lower quote of 90 through the vendor portal.
Assert that the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before opening Master QCS and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Assert that the lower quote ranks first, confirming the expected Vendor B outcome by price.
Award the entire event to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved award and read the resulting purchase order.
Assert that one PO line was created for the awarded quantity of 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event reached history.
Open the History tab after completion.
Assert that this plan's event appears in event history.
